name: NoSQL table (DynamoDB, on-demand)
summary: A single DynamoDB table billed per request, with encryption at rest and an optional sort key and TTL. Nothing to size, nothing running when idle.

parameters.name: partition_key
parameters.description: Attribute name for the partition key. String type.

parameters.name: sort_key
parameters.description: Optional sort key. Empty for a partition-key-only table.

parameters.name: ttl_attribute
parameters.description: Attribute holding a Unix timestamp after which items are deleted automatically. Empty disables TTL.

notes: On-demand billing only - provisioned capacity bills whether or not anything reads the table. Point-in-time recovery is off, so this is not for data worth recovering.
